# Quadratic

> > Quadratic is an AI-powered spreadsheet platform that combines Python, SQL, and JavaScript with traditional formulas for advanced data analysis and visualization.

Quadratic enables data professionals to perform sophisticated analysis using code-based spreadsheets with native support for databases, APIs, and AI assistance. The platform offers templates for finance, healthcare, marketing analytics, and more, while providing educational content on data analysis techniques and AI-powered workflows.

## Key Topics

- Quadratic AI
- Python
- SQL
- JavaScript
- Data analysis
- Spreadsheet formulas
- API integration
- Stock and revenue analysis
- Financial forecasting
- Database visualization
- AI-powered analysis
- Healthcare analytics
- Funnel analysis
- Sensitivity analysis
- Excel and CSV compatibility

## Core Platform Features

- [Spreadsheet Formulas: Modern Formula Experience in Quadratic](https://www.quadratichq.com/formulas): AI-powered formulas with multi-line editing, Python, SQL, JavaScript support

## Data Analysis & Visualization Guides

- [Why Every Data Pro Should use a Database Visualization Tool](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/why-you-need-a-database-visualization-tool-and-how-quadratic-helps): Compare database visualization tools and Quadratic's SQL/Python approach
- [The Best Coding Spreadsheets for Faster, Better Analysis](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/the-best-coding-spreadsheets-for-faster-better-analysis): Compare coding in Excel, Google Sheets, and Quadratic for data analysis
- [SQL data analytics: Build Trustworthy, Repeatable Insights](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/build-trustworthy-repeatable-data-analysis-using-sql): Best practices for SQL data validation and repeatable analysis workflows
- [Funnel Analysis 101: From Signup to Activation (and Beyond)](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/funnel-analysis-from-signup-to-activation-and-beyond): Measure conversion funnels and user progression with SQL templates
- [What is Sensitivity Analysis? Evaluating Risk and Uncertainty](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/what-is-sensitivity-analysis-evaluating-risk-and-uncertainty): Guide to sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, and risk evaluation
- [Logistic Regression vs Linear Regression: When to Use Which](https://www.quadratichq.com/blog/logistic-regression-vs-linear-regression-when-to-use-which-approach): Compare linear vs logistic regression for continuous vs categorical outcomes
